clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Dario era accanto a una poltrona di velluto.
clues.en: Dario was beside a velvet armchair.

clues.it: Nino era nella stessa stanza di Ugo.
clues.en: Nino was in the same room as Ugo.

clues.it: Fabio era l'unica persona su un tappeto persiano.
clues.en: Fabio was the only person on a persian carpet.

clues.it: Ugo era accanto a un tavolo da biliardo.
clues.en: Ugo was beside a billiard table.

clues.it: Luca era da solo nella Hall.
clues.en: Luca was alone in the Lobby.

clues.it: Anna era accanto a il bancone della reception.
clues.en: Anna was beside the reception desk.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Fabio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 3rd.

steps.it: Ugo può stare solo nella 7ª colonna: escludendola, a Dario resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Ugo can only be in the 7th column: ruling it out leaves Dario a single square: row 2nd, column 4th.
